headline: Ramp-up at new hospitals to aid recovery

highlights: EBITDA grew a strong 31.5% YoY, though a drag from new hospitals in existing and new clusters led to a 130bps fall in margins to 20%.
Healthy revenue traction at new hospitals has aided an EBITDA break-even at most of the hospitals.
No major greenfield capex ahead and better traction at new hospitals will likely lead the company on course of sequential margin improvement ahead.
We raise FY27/28E revenue by ~1–3% to factor in a faster ramp-up of new hospitals.
valuation: Valuation and risks KIMS continues to witness healthy traction across its mature clusters of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, supported by strong brand presence, established doctor networks and expansion of specialised clinical programmes.
Upgrade to BUY (earlier Add) with an unchanged target price of INR 885, based on 27x FY28E adj.

During Q2FY27, the fair value gain on call options stood at INR 132mn. • ~25% of funds from QIP proceeds are reserved for general corporate purposes, including loss funding of new hospitals and any potential smaller/minority acquisitions.
watch: Valuation and risks KIMS continues to witness healthy traction across its mature clusters of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, supported by strong brand presence, established doctor networks and expansion of specialised clinical programmes.
Key downside risks: Slowdown in growth in South India, and delays in capacity addition.
